insight: Built by German company deepset; its 2.0 release rewrote the framework around composable, typed pipelines.
name: Haystack
tagline: Open-source Python framework for production RAG and agents.
description: Orchestration framework for building LLM applications as modular pipelines — retrieval, routing, memory, and generation wired together with explicit, traceable data flow. It is model- and store-agnostic, integrating major providers and vector databases behind a stable component API. Aimed at production: serialization, logging, and deployment across cloud or on-prem.

modelSupport.notes: Integrates OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Hugging Face, and others.

edge: More production-oriented and explicitly composable than lighter agent libraries: typed pipelines give direct control over retrieval, routing, and memory.
cons: Pipeline model has a learning curve
